concept: ネオン以外を含む複数の方向性で、ComfyUI の出力品質が LLM 側（GenerateImage）に対してどれだけ落ちるかを見る
note: 品質ギャップの検証（techno）。LLM 側の探索セット 12 と同じセル指定の偶数番 12 件を ComfyUI で生成。参考列は LLM 側 24 枚全体の仕分け結果。SD1.5 は XL との比較用。

conditions.name: xl-12-techno
conditions.prompt_prefix: bold flat graphic inspired by Techno music, black or very dark background with one or two fluorescent light colors, large simple sharp forms, high contrast, glowing neon light as the main subject filling the frame
conditions.negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, people, face, photo, mockup, perspective grid floor, frame, border
conditions.reference: like 6 / dislike 11 / maybe 7（24 枚中 like 25%）

items.text: vertical white strobe light beams of irregular widths on black
concentric shockwave rings pulsing from the center in electric blue on black
beams of cyan light cutting through thick black fog with soft haze
a single huge glowing neon magenta circle with a hard edge on black
flickering broken glowing rectangles in white and blue as a glitchy strobe frame on black
stacked horizontal light bars of varied length in neon orange on black
giant speaker cone rings in fluorescent lime on black abstracted to concentric edges
pulsing dot field in neon cyan with a few oversized dots on black
warehouse haze with a few vertical neon tubes in magenta and blue
torn horizontal glitch bands in yellow and magenta on black
dense vertical equalizer-like columns in neon green and cyan on black, no numbers
spiral acid rings in fluorescent yellow on black
